locations.note: In Granada Ezio meets Luis again, an Assassin at the King's court, as Ferdinand and Isabella take the city.
In Venice Luis de Santángel asks Ezio to protect Christopher Columbus, and Ezio learns that Torquemada has arrested most of the Spanish Assassins.
In Barcelona Ezio finds the Assassins' headquarters taken by Inquisition soldiers and starts freeing the captured Brotherhood.

routes.name: Ezio in Spain
routes.note: 1491 to 1492: Ezio leaves Venice to protect Columbus, frees captured Assassins in Barcelona and ends in Granada as Ferdinand and Isabella take the city.
